text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you heard? Apparently,
someone out
there's invented a ramen
vending machine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With just a push of a button, it'll make a
fresh,
hot bowl of ramen for you
anytime!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we could get some installed
back in
Ireland? If we had an easy way
to connect with
other cultures, I think
more people would show an
interest in
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ramen... will be a bridge between
nations.
Mm-hm. ♪ Doesn't that just
sound lovely?
